name: Shutsugeki!! Otome-tachi no Senjou 2 ~Amakakeru Shougeki no Kizuna~
original_name: 出撃！！乙女たちの戦場2～天翔ける衝撃の絆～
source:
Join Sage and take the girls to the battlefield. The war strategy game contains dating sim elements and lots of fan-service moments. Get to know the girls in their free time, chat with them to unlock events and free battles, develop their statistics and pit them against your enemies. 

The sequel of the popular Shutsugeki! Otometachi no Senjou! has a completely new cast of characters, 40 girls and 20 boys, a new story dedicated to it and much more weapons. Drive a tank or pilot a fighter jet, don't let the girls suffer damages, though, as their uniforms might rip.
translation:
与Sage一同带领少女们奔赴战场。这款战争策略游戏融合了恋爱模拟元素，并有大量福利场面。利用闲暇了解少女们，与她们交谈以解锁事件和自由战斗，培养各项能力，再带领她们迎击敌人。

人气作品《出击！少女们的战场！》的续作采用了全新角色阵容，包括40名少女与20名少年，并准备了专属的新故事和更多武器。驾驶坦克或战斗机投入战斗，但别让少女们受到损伤，否则她们的制服可能会破裂。
